reviewBasis: ROOT inspected the complete seven-panel original projection figure, including all five tower outlines. Each original matches its unique tower footprint orientation and distinctive repeated plan; recess-filling wings and eastern facade projections are preserved.

Exact government source graph, CSUID/ObjectID component route and whole georeference cell match this tower. Measured original coverage of its target exceeds 99.7%; foreign-form excess is individually below 9 square metres. These figures describe these five exact sources and are not general acceptance thresholds.

The recorded podium-form overlaps and all original extension faces remain in evidence. Other-original projection coverage is contextual only; no blanket overlap permission, engineering claim, tower-to-tower support credit or geometry alteration.
Source identity only. Complete support, buried-face treatment, terrain, neighbour, device/browser and publication checks remain required.
